title: Show Your Debugging
user: Beginning developers using AI coding tools who need a lightweight practice constraint that preserves independent diagnosis and debugging skill.
smallest_useful_product: VS Code extension that asks for a one-line hypothesis before reveal, captures test output and the learner's chosen fix, then produces a local debugging receipt for review.
success_measure: Pilot learners independently repair 20% more repeated bug patterns after four weeks than a baseline set with no trace review.
constraints: Local-only source/test capture by default; never transmit proprietary code; clearly describe that receipts evidence process, not competence.
